Why not timber?

Built to outlast the garden around it

Timber cracks, warps, splits and rots. Real-Crete sleepers are made from concrete and steel, engineered above and beyond Australian standards.

  • No rot, no termitesWon't warp, split or rot, and can't be ravaged by termites.
  • No burn fumesFire-resistant, a safer choice for homes and commercial sites.
  • Maintenance-freeNo ongoing upkeep, saving you time and money.
